name: Run / RunOnce Registry Keys
purpose: Machine-wide or per-user autostart mechanism executing listed commands at logon/boot.
normal_baseline: Entries match known startup agents (AV, cloud sync clients, drivers).
anomalies: Entry pointing to a script interpreter with an encoded argument
New entry in a user-writable path added outside a software install event
anti_forensic_notes: Trivially removed by deleting the value; correlate against SOFTWARE/NTUSER.DAT hive backups (RegBack) to detect since-deleted entries.
